claims: The social video-commerce app Flip (itsflip.com) has shut down.
Flip allowed users to earn money by posting honest product reviews.
The Flip platform and its associated apps have ceased operations.

According to Flip's closure announcement, Flip's mission to provide a platform for honest reviews and creator videos came to a close after attempting to transition through different stages of social commerce.
Flip is listed as a deadpooled (discontinued) company.
Flip users watched short-form videos to discover products.
Flip consumers could directly purchase products reviewed in videos.
Flip creators earned money when viewers bought products they reviewed.
The Flip app paid out over $13 million to creators.
Flip is a defunct series of pocket video cameras.
Flip is the name of a recently shut down social commerce app.
Flip is an action to turn something over, such as a coin, page, or switch.
Flip is a somersault or aerial maneuver.
Flip is to buy and sell quickly in business or finance (e.g., flipping a house).
A different Flip app (an AI-native employee app) still operates at getflip.com.
